versions.changelog:
- Added a section to SKILL.md with direct APIDot entry points for ClawHub users.
- No functional or behavioral changes; documentation only.
- Removed the skill-card.md file for simplification.

Initial release of the apidot-runway-gen-4-5-api skill.

- Provides documentation-only support for APIDot Runway Gen-4.5 API workflows, including text-to-video and image-to-video integration guidance.
- Includes SKILL.md and non-executable references; does not contain scripts, executable files, or API clients.
- Offers async task submission, polling, webhook integration, and guides to official APIDot docs and model pages.
- Emphasizes secure handling of API keys and proper async job management.
- Directs users to official APIDot resources for examples, request formats, and integration best practices.
